subject: Supplemental SOC 2 artifacts: retention windows, privileged access extracts, and logging slices
messages:
From: Eve Chambers <eve.chambers@evexhealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Audit Operations <audit_ops@evexhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 01 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Supplemental artifact request: retention & privileged accounts

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for sending the SOC 2 Type II report. The audit team reviewed the report and had a few follow-ups where we need supplemental control evidence to close a couple control objectives related to authentication and privileged access. Can you provide the following scoped artifacts for the audit period 2028-03-01 through 2028-04-30: 

- A CSV export of privileged admin/service accounts with creation/deactivation timestamps and current owner (we need account type, last auth time, and entitlement level).
- A slice of authentication logs showing MFA enforcement outcomes and failures (we only need auth events for the audit window; PII may be redacted).
- Your log retention policy (what buckets/indices contain auth and keystore logs and their retention periods) and evidence that retention was enforced during the period (examples of purge jobs or retention lifecycle metadata).
- Any keystore rotation records (dates and rotation job IDs) for HSM/KMS keys used for signing/session tokens during the period.

If you can provide the artifacts or a mutually agreed plan and timeline by EOD Monday (2028-06-04), that would keep us on schedule. If anything above is sensitive, please flag and suggest alternate redaction.

Appreciate it —
Eve
Eve Chambers
Senior IT Auditor, EvexHealth

--
Attachment: audit-questionnaire-evex-2028.pdf (pdf stub)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Eve Chambers <eve.chambers@evexhealth.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, olga.petrov@redwood.com, Audit Operations <audit_ops@evexhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 01 Jun 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Supplemental artifact request: retention & privileged accounts

Eve —

Thanks for the clear list. We're happy to provide scoped extracts rather than full datasets. Laura (Access Controls) and Olga (Platform Logging) are looping in to confirm exact slices and redaction approach. Preliminary answers below: 

- Privileged account extract: we can produce a CSV with account_id, display_name, role_tag, created_at, disabled_at, last_auth_ts, owner_email. We'll filter to accounts with admin/service roles and include change history for the audit window.
- MFA/auth slices: we can provide a line-delimited JSONL file of auth events (timestamp, user_id (hashed), client_ip, result, mfa_used boolean). We will hash user identifiers and exclude token values.
- Retention policy: attaching our current retention policy PDF and will pull lifecycle metadata for the indices involved.
- Keystore rotation: we'll export rotation job metadata from the KMS audit trail; share job IDs and timestamps.

Laura/Olga — can you confirm timelines? Eve, assuming we deliver redacted extracts, does a secure Drive share + signed assurance note from us work, or do you need a different delivery method (DocuSign/secure upload)?

Thanks,
Tessa
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

--
(Attachment: log-retention-policy-2027-2028.pdf)

From: laura.bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Eve Chambers <eve.chambers@evexhealth.com>
Cc: olga.petrov@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 04 Jun 2028 09:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Supplemental artifact request: retention & privileged accounts

Hi all —

Plan and ETA:
- Privileged accounts CSV: will be exported from the identity service and include historical status changes (created/disabled) for accounts flagged with admin or service roles. Deliverable: redwood_privileged_accounts_202803-202804.csv. ETA: 2028-06-04 14:00 PT.
- Auth/MFA slice: Olga will generate a JSONL slice with hashed user ids; we'll include a readme that maps fields and our hashing approach. Deliverable: authn_log_slice_20280315-20280430.jsonl. ETA: 2028-06-04 15:00 PT.
- Keystore rotation evidence: export of KMS rotation records and job ids. ETA: 2028-06-04 11:00 PT.

Delivery method: we'll place files in a secure, access-controlled Google Drive folder and share view-only links plus a signed delivery confirmation PDF. If you require DocuSign acknowledgement, we can route the confirmation.

Notes on redaction: PII will be hashed; IPs will be truncated to /24 unless you require full values with additional NDA.

Thanks — delivering as promised.
Laura
Senior Manager, Access Controls
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment stubs referenced: redwood_privileged_accounts_202803-202804.csv (csv), authn_log_slice_20280315-20280430.jsonl (jsonl)

Files uploaded and shared to a restricted Drive folder (link below). Delivery includes: redwood_privileged_accounts_202803-202804.csv, authn_log_slice_20280315-20280430.jsonl, log-retention-policy-2027-2028.pdf, and a short assurance note (signed). We also exported KMS rotation job metadata: rotation-jobs-2028-03-2028-04.csv (attached in folder).

Drive share: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-example-redacted (access granted to audit_ops@evexhealth.com)

If you want an incremental follow-up with specific event ids for a narrow investigation, let us know the exact event timestamps or user ids (hashed) and we can pull deeper slices.

Regards,
Olga Petrov
